segments.text: This is the first video presentation for the Case Animal and Plant Biotechnology course.
segments.zh: 这是 CASE 动植物生物技术课程的第一个视频演示。

segments.text: As you view this video, be sure to make notes of important information.
segments.zh: 观看本视频时，请务必记下重要信息。

segments.text: Feel free to pause, repeat, and resume the video whenever necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时可以随时暂停、重播和继续播放视频。

segments.text: Safety in the Biotechnology Laboratory Lesson 1.2, Standard Operating Procedures
segments.zh: 生物技术实验室安全，第 1.2 课，标准操作程序

segments.text: You completed Lesson 1.1, Foundations of Biotechnology,
segments.zh: 你已经完成了第 1.1 课“生物技术基础”，

segments.text: during which you got a good idea of the breadth and depth of the biotechnology field.
segments.zh: 在那一课中，你对生物技术领域的广度和深度有了很好的了解。

segments.text: In all laboratories, safety is a priority.
segments.zh: 在所有实验室中，安全都是重中之重。

segments.text: In the Biotechnology Lab, safety may be of greater concern due to the biological hazards.
segments.zh: 在生物技术实验室中，由于存在生物危害，安全问题可能更加值得关注。

segments.text: There are many definitions for safety.
segments.zh: 安全有很多种定义。

segments.text: Most simply put, safety is the freedom from accidents.
segments.zh: 最简单地说，安全就是免于事故。

segments.text: Safety is a personal responsibility.
segments.zh: 安全是个人的责任。

segments.text: The person most responsible for your safety is you.
segments.zh: 对你的安全负有最大责任的人，就是你自己。

segments.text: You are also responsible for respecting the safety of others
segments.zh: 你也有责任尊重他人的安全，

segments.text: and acting in a manner that is safe for you, your classmates, and school property.
segments.zh: 并以对你自己、你的同学和学校财产都安全的方式行事。

segments.text: Having an attitude of safety is the first step to being responsible and respectful in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 树立安全意识，是在实验室中做到负责任和尊重他人的第一步。

segments.text: A safe attitude includes positive commitment to behaving responsibly.
segments.zh: 安全的态度包括积极地致力于负责任地行事。

segments.text: Personal protective equipment should be worn at all times in the laboratory
segments.zh: 在实验室里应始终穿戴个人防护装备，

segments.text: to minimize injuries and damage as well as to avoid contamination of research.
segments.zh: 以尽量减少伤害和损失，并避免研究受到污染。

segments.text: Throughout this course, you will be expected to choose and utilize appropriate PPE for all laboratory activity.
segments.zh: 在整个课程中，你需要为所有实验室活动选择并使用合适的个人防护装备。

segments.text: Working in the laboratory will help you understand many of the complex processes involved with agriculture and natural resource research.
segments.zh: 在实验室工作将帮助你理解农业和自然资源研究中涉及的许多复杂过程。

segments.text: However, there are hazards present when working with glass, chemicals, fire, and tools.
segments.zh: 然而，在使用玻璃器皿、化学品、火和工具时，都存在危害。

segments.text: Always use materials as instructed with care.
segments.zh: 始终按照指示小心使用材料。

segments.text: Most accidents can be avoided by following procedures and acting cautiously.
segments.zh: 大多数事故都可以通过遵守程序和谨慎行事来避免。

segments.text: Always consider the nature of the item you are disposing of and review proper disposal techniques.
segments.zh: 始终要考虑你所处置物品的性质，并复习正确的处置方法。

segments.text: Your teacher will provide specific, local instructions as necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时，你的老师会提供具体的、适用于本地的指导。

segments.text: Review systems for cleaning glassware and other materials in your situation.
segments.zh: 复习你所在场所清洗玻璃器皿和其他材料的制度。

segments.text: Disinfection and sterilization techniques are critical in biotechnology research.
segments.zh: 消毒和灭菌技术在生物技术研究中至关重要。

segments.text: Accidents happen in labs. Solutions get spilled and glass gets broken.
segments.zh: 实验室里会发生事故。溶液会洒出来，玻璃器皿会打碎。

segments.text: Due to the nature of chemicals used, please report all spills and broken items to your teacher.
segments.zh: 鉴于所用化学品的性质，请把所有洒漏和破损物品报告给你的老师。

segments.text: Work together to clean up properly and safely.
segments.zh: 一起合作，正确、安全地进行清理。

segments.text: The lab facility is equipped with spill kits and equipment.
segments.zh: 实验室配备了泄漏应急包和相关设备。

segments.text: You will review the locations and use of these items in this lesson.
segments.zh: 在本课中，你将了解这些物品的存放位置和使用方法。

segments.text: In research, procedures and protocols must be carefully documented in order to repeat experiments and even pursue future patents.
segments.zh: 在研究中，必须仔细记录程序和方案，以便重复实验，甚至申请未来的专利。

segments.text: Notebooks may be used to identify potential unsafe reactions or errors in procedures that led to accidents.
segments.zh: 记录本可以用来找出可能导致事故的潜在不安全反应或程序错误。

segments.text: Be sure to record everything accurately.
segments.zh: 一定要准确地记录一切。

segments.text: When recording data, it is helpful to use charts, graphs, tables, pictures, or any combinations of those.
segments.zh: 记录数据时，使用图表、曲线图、表格、图片或它们的任意组合会很有帮助。

segments.text: Refer to the Laboratory Notebook Guidelines document for your textbook when questions arise.
segments.zh: 有疑问时，请参阅教材中的《实验记录本指南》文件。

segments.text: As a review, marker highlight three key points in your notes that are important to remember from this presentation.
segments.zh: 作为复习，请在笔记中标记或突出显示本演示中需要记住的三个要点。

segments.text: List two ideas or concepts that relate to previous knowledge.
segments.zh: 列出两个与已有知识相关的观点或概念。

segments.text: List any questions you have about this topic.
segments.zh: 列出你对这个主题的任何疑问。

segments.text: Discuss these questions with your instructor.
segments.zh: 与你的老师讨论这些问题。

segments.text: Keep any notes you have from this presentation organized and available for use throughout the course.
segments.zh: 把你在本演示中做的所有笔记整理好，以便在整个课程中随时使用。

segments.text: Through activity 121, Surrounded by Safety, you will determine safe practices, identify safety equipment,
segments.zh: 通过活动 1.2.1“安全环绕”，你将确定安全的操作方法，识别安全设备，

segments.text: and explain how to use safety equipment appropriately in the biotechnology laboratory.
segments.zh: 并说明如何在生物技术实验室中正确使用安全设备。

segments.text: Diligence and following safety procedures and rules will improve your professional success during research.
segments.zh: 勤勉认真、遵守安全程序和规则，将有助于你在研究工作中取得职业上的成功。

segments.text: Your teacher will provide more instructions.
segments.zh: 你的老师会提供更多说明。
